title: Drip Irrigation & Automated Fertigation
description: Pressure-compensating inline drippers delivering water and 100% water-soluble fertilizers directly to the crop root zone.
control: Operate at 1.2-1.5 bar pressure. Flush laterals weekly and run seasonal acid flushing (HCl at pH 4.0) to prevent dripper emitter clogging.
farming_details: Saves 40-60% irrigation water compared to conventional flood irrigation, increases nitrogen use efficiency (NUE) to 75%, and provides 20-35% yield gain. Eligible for up to 55% capital subsidy under PMKSY (Per Drop More Crop).

title: Agricultural Spraying & Health Drones (UAV)
description: DGCA-certified hexacopter agricultural drone equipped with rotary atomizers for ultra-low volume foliar spraying of bio-pesticides and micro-nutrients.
control: Ultra-low volume spraying using 10 liters of water per acre compared to 150-200 liters in manual knapsack spraying. Rotor downwash ensures uniform coverage on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
farming_details: Sprays 1 acre in 6-8 minutes. Eliminates toxic chemical exposure for manual farm workers. Eligible for 40-50% subsidy under SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization).

title: Aphids & Sucking Pest Complex
crop: Cotton, Chilli, Tomato, Brinjal, Pulses, Mustard
disease: Vector of Cucumber Mosaic Virus (CMV) and PVY
description: Colonies of tiny green, yellow, or black soft-bodied sucking insects clustered on the underside of young leaves and tender apical shoots.
control:
• Biological: Spray Verticillium lecanii or Beauveria bassiana @ 5 g/L under high humidity.
• Prophylactic: Install Yellow Sticky Traps @ 15-20 traps/acre and spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE).
• Chemical Pesticide: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 ml/L, Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.2 g/L, or Flonicamid 50% WG @ 0.3 g/L.
farming_details: Aphids excrete sweet sticky honeydew attracting black sooty mold fungus (Capnodium spp.) which halts photosynthesis. Economic Threshold Level (ETL): 10% affected plants or 15-20 aphids per leaf.

title: Hydroponic NFT & Soilless Cultivation
crop: Lettuce, Spinach, Herbs, Cherry Tomato, Strawberry
description: Nutrient Film Technique (NFT) and closed-loop recirculating soilless channels feeding crops with oxygenated, nutrient-balanced aqueous solution.
control: Maintain EC between 1.4-2.2 mS/cm and solution pH between 5.8-6.5. Sterilize recirculating water using UV or ozone biofilters.
farming_details: Uses 90-95% less water than open-field cultivation. Completely eliminates soil-borne fungal pathogens (Fusarium, Pythium) and weeds. Delivers 30-40% faster crop cycles.

title: Vertical Indoor Farming & Controlled Environments
crop: Microgreens, Exotic Vegetables, Salad Greens, Basil
description: Multi-tier vertical indoor racking equipped with customized spectrum LED grow lights, automated HVAC climate regulation, and CO2 enrichment.
control: HEPA air filtration and positive air pressure prevent pest entry, eliminating any need for chemical pesticides.
farming_details: Achieves 10-20x higher productivity per unit land area. Completely insulated against heatwaves, unseasonal rain, and severe droughts.

title: Precision Agriculture & Connected Smart Tractors
description: Auto-steered smart tractor equipped with RTK-GPS navigation, section-controlled seed drills, and real-time field telematics.
control: Calibrate variable rate application (VRA) algorithms to match satellite soil fertility prescription zones.
farming_details: Eliminates overlapping tractor passes, slashing diesel fuel consumption by 15-20% and seed wastage by 10%. Supported under SMAM farm mechanization schemes.

title: On-Farm Automated Weather Station (AWS)
disease: Early Fungal Blight, Stripe Rust Prediction
description: Solar-powered microclimate sensor mast measuring solar radiation, wind speed, air temperature, relative humidity, rain rate, and leaf wetness.
control: Uses sensor data to compute Reference Evapotranspiration (ET0) via FAO-56 Penman-Monteith for precision irrigation scheduling.
farming_details: Forecasts disease infection risk 48-72 hours in advance based on consecutive hours of leaf wetness and temperature. Eligible for 50% subsidy under MIDH.

title: Soil Health, Organic Humus & Composting
description: Enriched microbial composting and bio-humus application to restore Soil Organic Carbon (SOC) and beneficial microbial biomass.
control: Apply 4-5 tonnes/acre of well-decomposed FYM or vermicompost combined with Trichoderma viride bio-fertilizer before sowing.
farming_details: Every 1% increase in Soil Organic Carbon enables soil to hold up to 20,000 gallons of extra water per acre, buffering crops against drought stress. Supported under PKVY.

title: High-Yield Fresh Organic Vegetable Production
description: High-density vegetable farming integrating silver-black reflective mulch, drip fertigation, and biological integrated pest management (IPM).
control: Use pheromone traps (5 traps/acre) for fruit borers and spray Neem oil (10,000 ppm @ 2 ml/L) as a prophylactic pest repellent.
farming_details: Delivers 3-4x higher net return per acre compared to traditional cereal mono-cropping through continuous weekly harvest schedules.

title: Aquaponics & Closed-Loop Fish-Plant Symbiosis
crop: Leafy Vegetables, Mint, Herbs + Tilapia / Carp Fish
description: Integrated recirculating aquaculture system where beneficial nitrifying bacteria convert fish excretion (ammonia) into bio-available nitrates for plant uptake.
control: Maintain biological biofilters and continuous water aeration. Avoid synthetic pesticides to protect fish health.
farming_details: Conserves 95% water via closed recirculating cycles while producing two commercial harvest products (protein fish + organic greens). Supported under PMMSY.

title: Climate-Controlled Polyhouses & Greenhouses
crop: Colored Capsicum, Dutch Roses, Cherry Tomato, Cucumber
description: Naturally ventilated or pad-fan cooled GI structural greenhouse with 200-micron UV-stabilized anti-fog polyfilm cladding.
control: Maintain insect-proof 40-mesh netting on ventilation openings. Apply micro-sprinklers/foggers to regulate vapor pressure deficit (VPD).
farming_details: Achieves 4-6x higher productivity with 90% A-grade export quality produce. Eligible for 50% capital subsidy under the National Horticulture Board (NHB).

title: NDVI Satellite & Aerial Multispectral Health Mapping
description: High-resolution satellite and multispectral imagery providing Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) field zoning maps.
control: Generate Variable Rate Application (VRA) maps to target fertilizer and pesticide sprays only on stressed crop zones, cutting input costs by 20-30%.
farming_details: Detects crop canopy moisture stress, chlorophyll deficiency, and disease foci 7-10 days before symptoms become visible to the naked eye.

title: Conservation Tillage & Crop Residue Mulching
crop: Wheat following Rice, Maize, Soybean, Pulses
description: Direct zero-till seeding into standing crop stubble using Happy Seeders combined with surface straw mulching.
control: Leaves a 3-4 inch organic mulch blanket on the soil surface, suppressing weed emergence by 60-70% and preventing soil erosion.
farming_details: Completely stops crop stubble burning. Retains 30-40% residual soil moisture from previous monsoon rains. Supported under Central CRM schemes.

title: Solar Agricultural Pumping Systems (PM-KUSUM)
description: Photovoltaic solar water pump array with Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) optimized for off-grid drip and sprinkler irrigation.
control: Automated DC/AC controller matches pump RPM to solar irradiance, providing dependable daytime irrigation.
farming_details: Eliminates diesel fuel recurring costs and electrical grid dependence. Eligible for 60% capital subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) under PM-KUSUM Scheme.

title: Digital Farm Management Software & Smart Decision Apps
description: Digital farm management app and tablet dashboard integrating live IoT sensor feeds, satellite NDVI, mandi price analytics, and agronomic AI copilot.
control: Provides automated reminders for spray dates, irrigation intervals, fertilizer split doses, and market price spikes.
farming_details: Maintains digital traceability logs for export and organic certification. Integrated with the national Digital Agriculture Mission and AgriStack APIs.

title: Farm Mechanization & Heavy Machinery
description: High-efficiency 4WD tractors with hydraulic implements, laser land levelers, and automated multi-crop seed drills.
control: Laser land leveling creates a perfectly flat field grade, reducing water application depth and saving 20-25% irrigation water.
farming_details: Completes field preparation within critical narrow weather windows, preventing planting delays. Subsidized up to 40-50% under SMAM.
